questions.question: TLS handshake qanday ishlaydi va sertifikat nima uchun kerak?
questions.explanation: TLS — shifrlash + server autentifikatsiyasi. Sertifikat = public key + domen nomi + muddat, CA imzolagan. Client zanjirni ishonchli root CA'gacha tekshiradi, keyin key exchange (ECDHE) bilan session kalit kelishiladi.

questions.question: `openssl` bilan sertifikatni tekshirish: muddat, domen, zanjir, masofaviy server.
questions.explanation: Masofaviy: `openssl s_client -connect host:443 -servername host -showcerts`. Fayl: `openssl x509 -in cert.pem -noout -text/-dates/-subject/-issuer/-ext subjectAltName`. Muddat tekshiruvi: `-checkend`.

questions.question: CSR yaratish, self-signed sertifikat, formatlar: PEM, DER, PFX/P12, CRT/KEY.
questions.explanation: `openssl req -new -newkey ... -keyout key.pem -out req.csr` — CA'ga beriladigan so'rov. Self-signed: `openssl req -x509`. PEM — base64 (-----BEGIN), DER — binary, PFX/P12 — kalit+sertifikat+zanjir bitta parol bilan (Windows/Java).

questions.question: Let's Encrypt / certbot: sertifikat olish va avtomatik yangilash qanday?
questions.explanation: certbot ACME protokoli orqali domenni tasdiqlaydi (HTTP-01: :80'da token fayl; DNS-01: TXT yozuv, wildcard uchun). Sertifikat 90 kun; certbot timer kuniga 2 marta tekshiradi, 30 kun qolganda yangilaydi; deploy hook bilan nginx reload.

questions.question: Nginx asosiy buyruqlari va config tuzilishi: `nginx -t`, reload, server block, location.
questions.explanation: `nginx -t` sintaksis tekshiruvi, `systemctl reload nginx` (yoki `nginx -s reload`) downtime'siz. Tuzilma: `/etc/nginx/nginx.conf` -> `http {}` -> `server {}` (sites-enabled / conf.d) -> `location {}`. `nginx -T` — to'liq yig'ilgan config.

questions.question: Nginx'ni reverse proxy + TLS sifatida sozlash (Go/Node backend oldida).
questions.explanation: `proxy_pass http://upstream;` + kerakli header'lar (Host, X-Real-IP, X-Forwarded-For, X-Forwarded-Proto), timeout'lar, keepalive upstream, 80 -> 443 redirect, ssl_certificate fullchain, HSTS.

questions.question: Nginx 502 Bad Gateway, 504 Gateway Timeout, 413, 499 — sabablari va tekshirish.
questions.explanation: 502 — upstream'ga ulanib bo'lmadi yoki noto'g'ri javob (backend o'lgan, noto'g'ri port, socket ruxsati, SELinux). 504 — upstream vaqtida javob bermadi (proxy_read_timeout). 413 — client_max_body_size. 499 — client nginx javobini kutmay ulanishni yopdi.

questions.question: Nginx performance va himoya: worker'lar, keepalive, gzip, caching, rate limiting.
questions.explanation: `worker_processes auto`, `worker_connections`, `worker_rlimit_nofile`; keepalive client/upstream; gzip/brotli; `proxy_cache`; `limit_req_zone` + `limit_conn`; `server_tokens off`; timeout'lar (slowloris).

questions.question: Nginx reverse proxy sifatida qanday sozlanadi (`proxy_pass`)?
questions.explanation: Nginx client so'rovini qabul qilib backend'ga (`proxy_pass`) uzatadi; asl Host va client IP'ni header'lar orqali o'tkazish kerak.

questions.question: Nginx konfiguratsiyasini tekshirish va qayta yuklash: `nginx -t`, reload va restart farqi?
questions.explanation: `nginx -t` — sintaksis va fayllarni tekshiradi. reload (`nginx -s reload`/`systemctl reload nginx`) — yangi worker'lar yangi config bilan, eskilari mavjud ulanishlarni tugatadi: downtime yo'q. restart — hamma ulanish uziladi.

questions.question: `server` va `location` bloklari qanday tanlanadi?
questions.explanation: `server` — `listen` port va `server_name` (Host header) bo'yicha tanlanadi; mos kelmasa `default_server`. `location` — URI bo'yicha: `=` aniq, `^~` prefix (regex'ni to'xtatadi), `~`/`~*` regex (tartib bo'yicha), aks holda eng uzun prefix.

questions.question: Let's Encrypt (certbot) bilan HTTPS qanday yoqiladi va yangilanadi?
questions.explanation: certbot ACME protokoli orqali domen egaligini tekshiradi (HTTP-01 yoki DNS-01), 90 kunlik sertifikat oladi, Nginx config'ga qo'shadi. Yangilash systemd timer/cron bilan avtomatik (`certbot renew`).

questions.question: HTTP'dan HTTPS'ga redirect va zamonaviy TLS sozlamalari?
questions.explanation: 80-port'da 301 redirect, 443'da `ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3`, kuchli cipher'lar, HTTP/2, HSTS header, OCSP stapling.

questions.question: Nginx bilan load balancing: `upstream`, algoritmlar, health check?
questions.explanation: `upstream` blokida backend'lar; default round-robin, `least_conn`, `ip_hash` (sticky). Open-source Nginx'da passive health check: `max_fails`/`fail_timeout` — xato bergan server vaqtincha chiqariladi.

questions.question: 502 Bad Gateway va 504 Gateway Timeout — farqi va qanday debug qilinadi?
questions.explanation: 502 — Nginx backend'dan yaroqli javob ololmadi (backend o'chgan, port noto'g'ri, ulanish rad etildi, crash). 504 — backend ulandi, lekin `proxy_read_timeout` ichida javob bermadi (sekin so'rov, DB lock).

questions.question: Nginx'da rate limiting va asosiy himoya sozlamalari?
questions.explanation: `limit_req_zone` (leaky bucket) IP bo'yicha so'rov tezligini cheklaydi, `limit_conn` — bir vaqtdagi ulanishlar. Qo'shimcha: `client_max_body_size`, `server_tokens off`, security header'lar, timeout'lar.

questions.question: Nginx performance: worker'lar, keepalive, gzip, caching qanday sozlanadi?
questions.explanation: `worker_processes auto` (CPU yadrolari), `worker_connections` va `worker_rlimit_nofile`, client va upstream keepalive, `gzip`/brotli matn uchun, statik fayllar uchun `sendfile` va `expires`, `proxy_cache` bilan backend javoblarini cache.

questions.question: Nginx'da WebSocket va gRPC proxy qilishning o'ziga xosligi?
questions.explanation: WebSocket — HTTP/1.1 Upgrade: `Upgrade` va `Connection` header'larini uzatish va uzoq `proxy_read_timeout`. gRPC — HTTP/2 talab qiladi: `grpc_pass`, `http2` yoqilgan listener.
